# Generated file — do not edit by hand

This file is an output. Change its source instead and regenerate:

- `*.g.dart` (Drift tables, DAOs, JSON) — `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` (or `tool/release/release gen`).
- `app_localizations*.dart` — edit `lib/l10n/app_*.arb`, then `flutter gen-l10n`.

If the generated output looks wrong, the fix is in the table, DAO, annotation or ARB that produced it.
